cards.example_es: En las reuniones largas me muero de aburrimiento.
cards.example_en: I die of boredom in long meetings.

cards.example_es: Se le pasó el enfado enseguida.
cards.example_en: His anger passed quickly.

cards.example_es: Me da pena que te vayas.
cards.example_en: I'm sad that you're leaving.

cards.example_es: Me hace mucha ilusión verte.
cards.example_en: I'm really looking forward to seeing you.

cards.example_es: Me da pereza ir al gimnasio hoy.
cards.example_en: I can't be bothered to go to the gym today.

cards.example_es: Me da asco la comida recalentada.
cards.example_en: Reheated food disgusts me.

cards.example_es: Tengo miedo a volar.
cards.example_en: I'm afraid of flying.

cards.example_es: Me da vergüenza hablar en público.
cards.example_en: I'm embarrassed to speak in public.

cards.example_es: Tiene celos de su hermano pequeño.
cards.example_en: He's jealous of his little brother.

cards.example_es: Me da rabia perder el autobús por un minuto.
cards.example_en: It drives me mad to miss the bus by a minute.

cards.example_es: Me pongo nervioso antes de los exámenes.
cards.example_en: I get nervous before exams.

cards.example_es: Me sentó fatal que no me llamaras.
cards.example_en: It upset me that you didn't call.

cards.example_es: Estoy harta del ruido de las obras.
cards.example_en: I'm fed up with the noise of the building work.

cards.example_es: No soporto que me interrumpan.
cards.example_en: I can't stand being interrupted.

cards.example_es: No aguanto el calor de agosto.
cards.example_en: I can't bear the August heat.

cards.example_es: Tengo la manía de ordenar los libros por colores.
cards.example_en: I have a habit of arranging books by colour.

cards.example_es: Odio hacer cola.
cards.example_en: I hate queuing.

cards.example_es: ¿Te molesta que abra la ventana?
cards.example_en: Do you mind if I open the window?

cards.example_es: Vivo con mi pareja en Triana.
cards.example_en: I live with my partner in Triana.

cards.example_es: Discutimos por quién friega los platos.
cards.example_en: We argue about who does the dishes.

cards.example_es: Discutieron, pero se reconciliaron enseguida.
cards.example_en: They argued, but made up straight away.

cards.example_es: Me llevo muy bien con mi compañera de piso.
cards.example_en: I get on very well with my flatmate.

cards.example_es: —¿Estás enfadado? —¡Qué va!
cards.example_en: —Are you angry? —Not at all!

cards.example_es: —Lo has roto tú. —¡Qué dices! Yo no he sido.
cards.example_en: —You broke it. —What are you talking about! It wasn't me.

cards.example_es: Yo no diría eso; simplemente es tímido.
cards.example_en: I wouldn't say that; he's just shy.

cards.example_es: A mi modo de ver, el problema es otro.
cards.example_en: The way I see it, the problem is something else.

cards.es: no estar del todo de acuerdo
cards.example_es: No estoy del todo de acuerdo contigo.
cards.example_en: I don't completely agree with you.

cards.example_es: Lo que pasa es que no tengo tiempo.
cards.example_en: The thing is, I don't have time.

cards.example_es: Me encanta que me cocines.
cards.example_en: I love it when you cook for me.

cards.example_es: Le apasiona la fotografía.
cards.example_en: She's passionate about photography.
